name: drop-random-filter
description: A random item of a placed unit's item set given an equipment type and a tag (test.md 'A drop table's random item (Y?I?)'; branch we-batch-5, 2026-11-20): drop-random.w3x (tests/fixtures/we-specs/make-drop-random.mjs: a footman at 0,0 with the sets YiI2 50 % and YYI/ 100 %; the opening view shows it at 745,390), u, Escape, a double-click on it (745,390), Unit Properties' Items Dropped tab (785,414), the first entry (650,480), Edit Item (807,555): Choose Item offers for Random a level, a class, an equipment type and a tag; Head (the list at 1015,337, its row 381) and Droppable (1015,361, row 405), OK, OK. The editor's war3mapUnits.doo keeps the entry as id 0x5a45490a ('Z', class + 9 equipment + 90 tag + 810 (level + 1) as two bytes around 'I': lib/objects/randomids.ts) and its script ChooseRandomItemExWithFilter( ITEM_TYPE_PERMANENT, 2, EQUIPMENT_TYPE_HEAD, ITEMTAG_TYPE_DROPPABLE ). Studio has no equipment or tag in its random item picker, so its step writes that id into the project and generates the script; the drop lines are compared

steps.eval: const f = 'map/war3mapUnits.doo.json'; const doo = JSON.parse(await w3.workspace.readText(f)); const foot = doo.units.find((u) => u.id === 'hfoo'); if (foot?.itemSets?.[0]?.[0]?.id !== 'YiI2') throw new Error('the footman has no YiI2 first'); foot.itemSets[0][0].id = '0x5a45490a'; await w3.workspace.writeText(f, JSON.stringify(doo, null, 1)); await w3.workspace.refresh();
